answer: Bind each agent key to one utility smart meter. The operator links it through the utility's Green Button Connect OAuth; PoA keeps a salted hash of the meter ID, and a second key on that meter merges into the first. Each fake then needs a real service account, about $25/month in fixed charges, so 100 aliases cost $2,500/month. A farm leasing sub-meters in one timber warehouse shows the same load ripple on every meter: keys whose 15-minute interval data correlates above 0.9 collapse to one seat pending juror review. Homes in one canyon town share weather, not lockstep spikes.
